name: The Villainess Is Adored by the Prince of the Neighbor Kingdom
description: Tiararose Lapis Clamentile is set to marry Hartknights, crown prince of Lapis Lazuli—until she suddenly remembers her past life and realizes she’s been reincarnated into her favorite game, The Ring of Lapis Lazuli, as the doomed villainess! But just as she’s about to lose hope, the crown prince of Aquasteed proposes instead. Could this unexpected turn finally lead to a happy ending of her own?

videos.title: A Love That Begins with the Ending
videos.overview: Tiararose is shocked when her engagement is broken... but then the prince of another kingdom proposes to her.

videos.title: Prince Aqua, Do You Like Sugar?
videos.overview: As Aquasteed and Tiararose grow closer, Hartknights begins to feel guilty for what he did to Tiararose.

videos.title: A Proposal Sweeter Than Honey
videos.overview: Aquasteed recalls his first encounter with Tiararose and the events leading up to their engagement.

videos.title: The Sweetest Kiss in the World
videos.overview: After Akari uses the Holy Prayer, Tiararose worries that she'll lose yet another fiancé to her.

videos.title: The Mermaid Knows Not of Love
videos.overview: Tiararose finally meets Icilla, the heroine of the sequel to The Ring of Lapis Lazuli.

videos.title: Tiara in the Sleeping Forest
videos.overview: The Forest Fairy King has taken notice of Tiara and it seems he doesn't want to let her go.

videos.title: Hold Me... Tighter
videos.overview: The Forest Fairy King has taken Tiararose to his castle, so she bargains with the fairies to return home.

videos.title: Blessings on the Teary Bride
videos.overview: It's finally time for Tiararose and Aquasteed's wedding... but will Icilla ruin the bride's big day?

videos.title: A Love Like Ripples on the Water
videos.overview: The desserts Tiararose bakes keep disappearing. Could it be the work of fairies?

videos.title: Whisper That You Love Me
videos.overview: Icilla tries to find out why the Sea Fairy King hates Tiararose... and faces a temptation she never expected.

videos.title: My Beautiful Lady
videos.overview: The ocean has turned black with the Sea Fairy King's rage. Can Tiararose and Aquasteed restore it?

videos.title: Love Is Always and Forever
videos.overview: After healing the ocean, can Tiararose finally get on the Sea Fairy King's good side and earn her blessing?
